en.title: 2026 TV Premiere Calendar: Your Guide to Next Year's Binge-Worthy Series
en.summary: Get ready to clear your schedules, TV fanatics! We've got an early look at the 2026 premiere dates, from returning favorites to brand-new series set to dominate your watchlists.
en.body:
The calendar for 2026 is already beginning to fill up, promising a packed year of television for dedicated fans. While many dates remain fluid, early announcements from networks and streamers are giving us a tantalizing glimpse of what's to come. This is your essential guide to navigating the premiere dates for both returning fan-favorites and exciting new series that are poised to capture our attention.

Among the early highlights, **Trying** is set to return for its fifth season on Apple TV, continuing the heartwarming — and often chaotic — journey of Nikki and Jason. Netflix is also dropping a slate of new and returning shows, including **Little House on the Prairie Season 1**, a reimagining that fans will undoubtedly be dissecting. HBO is bringing the drama with **The Man Will Burn**, while Peacock offers **The Five Star Weekend**. For those who love a good mystery, **Murder in Glitterball City** is slated for an HBO premiere, and Hulu is diving into true crime with **Girl on the Run: The Hunt for America's Most Wanted Woman**. Paramount+ is also entering the fray with the premiere of **Wild Boys: Strangers in Town**.

## Anticipated Returns and Bold New Ventures

Beyond the initial February and July announcements, the summer and fall of 2026 are shaping up to be particularly exciting. **Survival of the Thickest** will air its final season on Netflix, marking the end of an era for its dedicated following. Apple TV+ is slated to bring back the critically acclaimed **Silo**, a show that has consistently delivered mind-bending science fiction and intense character development. We're also seeing intriguing new titles like **Victoria of Many Faces** and **Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games**, suggesting a diverse range of genres and stories hitting our screens. The sheer volume of content across platforms like Netflix, HBO, Hulu, and Apple TV+ means that staying on top of every premiere requires vigilance, but the payoff is a year filled with potential water-cooler moments and deep-dive fan discussions.

## What This Means for Your Watchlist

For the dedicated series fan, these premiere dates are more than just calendar entries; they are strategic markers for planning viewing schedules and diving headfirst into new narrative worlds. The overlapping releases and the sheer breadth of genres mean that the era of passive viewing is long gone. We are active participants, curating our own festival of storytelling. The anticipation for returning seasons, like **Trying Season 5** or the potential for more **Silo**, fuels online communities, sparking theories and debates long before the first episode airs. The introduction of new shows like **Wild Boys: Strangers in Town** offers fresh opportunities to discover compelling characters and intricate plots that could become the next big obsession.

## What's Next

As the year progresses, expect continuous updates to this calendar. Networks and streamers will announce more dates, revealing the full scope of their 2026 offerings. Keep this guide bookmarked as we track every major premiere and return, ensuring you never miss a moment of the shows that matter.
